name: 2026-11-23-carousel-pano
prompt: Ultra-wide photorealistic still-life photograph, one long continuous pale off-white stone countertop running the full width of the frame, seen from a low front angle, seamless soft off-white wall behind it (colour #F4F7F5) with no corners, no windows, no furniture. Objects stand in a single row along the counter, evenly spaced with generous empty space between them: far left a brass rubber stamp resting on a folded property sale deed with a light green border; then a neat stack of Indian 500 rupee note bundles tied with paper bands; then a small white architectural scale model of a modern residential apartment tower; then a car key resting on a small numbered parking token; far right a set of brass house keys on a teal keyring. Bright natural daylight from the left, soft realistic shadows on the counter, high-key clean look, crisp detail, true colours with subtle teal and green tints, the background fading to pure flat off-white at the top and the far left and right edges. No text, no readable writing, no logos, no watermarks, no people, no hands.
